description_en: Queries abnormal SQL patterns within a time range
description_zh: 对指定时间范围内，执行指标异常的Pattern进行检测
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-abnormal-pattern-detection --db-cluster-id am-xxxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --start-time 2011-06-01T16:00Z --end-time 2021-05-18T06:30Z --lang zh --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAbnormalPatternDetection

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region, including cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看目标地域下所有AnalyticDB MySQL集群的详情，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html接口查看集群的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间。使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The language. Valid values:

zh (default): simplified Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
语言配置，取值说明：
zh：简体中文（默认语言）。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang
